name: Post-demo follow-up
description: After a live demo: outline → next-day personal + feature → next-steps with the decision maker (Tue/Fri friendly).

stages.label: Outreach 1 · Outline
stages.hint: Same day as the demo — send the outline while it’s fresh.

stages.label: Outreach 2 · Demo callout
stages.hint: Next day — reference something specific they said on the demo. Edit the template (or fill {{demo_note}}) before sending.

stages.label: Outreach 3 · Feature deep-dive
stages.hint: Same day as Outreach 2 by default (about an hour later). Change Day to 2+ if you want it later — e.g. Day 5 instead of Day 1.

stages.label: Outreach 4 · Next steps / decision maker
stages.hint: A few days later — circle back on next steps with the next decision maker. Prefer Tuesday or Friday (Mon/Tue demos → Friday; Wed–Fri demos → next Tuesday). Or set Day below.
